note: Topic queue for the Blog Writer agent. It takes the FIRST entry each run, writes that article to docs/blog-post-format.md, ships it live, and removes the entry in the same commit. Louis: add/reorder/delete topics freely - the agent only ever touches the front of the queue. Required per entry: title, slug, categorySlug, angle (the brief: what the post says and who it is for). Optional: keyword (main SEO keyword, derived from the title when absent), length ('focused' about 1000-1600 and led by the subject, 'standard' 3000-3500, or 'pillar' 4500-5000; defaults to standard), bannerImage (when missing, the agent reuses the fallback banner for that category and flags it in MARCUS_HANDOFF.md so a custom banner can be swapped in later). The agent's full job description is docs/BLOG_WRITER_AGENT.md. CURRENT PRIORITY (Louis, 2026-09-01): the first 13 entries are the Pinterest funnel batch, written at roughly two a day until they are done. They correspond to Pinterest content already publishing, so a pin about Genesis 1 lands on the Genesis 1 article rather than a generic page. The previous queue resumes underneath them, unchanged.
